releaseGates: No browser source may use sb_publishable_ as a bearer token.
No Admin browser source or storage may contain a Staff access JWT or refresh token.
Only declared custom-auth functions may set verify_jwt=false.
Every verify_jwt=false function must explicitly validate apikey and route-specific authorization.
Every Staff route must validate a real user JWT with auth.getUser before privileged access.
Every Admin mutation must pass valid origin, encrypted cookie, CSRF, current Staff claims, AAL2, game ownership and route policy.
Every Player route must resolve identity from an active opaque session and reject client ownership fields.
Every internal Business worker request must have an empty body, reject browser identity headers, pass timestamped exact-path/body HMAC verification and claim its nonce before service-role access.
No secret, service-role, legacy anon JWT, purchase code or raw internal UUID may appear in browser runtime configuration or logs.
The legacy classroom-api must receive no direct browser traffic before production cutover.
Connected local and isolated-staging journeys must prove login, refresh, logout, cookie clearing, CSRF denial, MFA denial, permission denial and session revocation.
